repos_data.description: Unified deployment management MCP server for Vercel, Render, Railway, and Fly.io
Open-source macOS menu bar app to monitor Vercel deployment status in real time (build/ready/error).

Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Jira. Equips AI systems (LLMs) with tools to list/get projects, search/get issues (using JQL/ID), and view dev info (commits, PRs). Connects AI capabilities directly into Jira project management and issue tracking workflows.

Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for TrackMage API integration, with support for 1600+ carriers worldwide. Enables AI assistants to track shipments, manage logistics, create orders, and monitor package delivery   statuses. Features OAuth authentication, carrier detection, and real-time tracking updates.
A Model Context Protocol server for integrating HackMD's note-taking platform with AI assistants.

The deploy button for AI coding agents - MCP server connecting Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Trae & Antigravity to your own FTP/FTPS/SFTP servers. Multi-server, path jail, read-only mode, dry-run, FileZilla import, one-command setup.

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI-powered search and querying capabilities for the Vercel AI SDK documentation. This project enables developers to ask questions about the Vercel AI SDK and receive accurate, contextualized responses based on the official documentation.
MCP server for npm package management — 32 tools for publish, install, audit, search, security & more
MCP server for MadeOnSol Solana KOL intelligence — use from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client
MCP server for deploying live HTTPS websites via SiteLauncher. Instant subdomains or custom .xyz domains, paid with USDC on Base chain.
